name: Show Package Contents
description: Show Package Contents is a small online museum of portable gadgets from around the millennium, each in a see-through shell that you can turn round and hold up to the light.

image.alt: A pager with a clear aqua shell, seen from the front: a dark screen and three black buttons, the inside hidden by the tinted plastic.
